mn84:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno Madhurāyaṃ viharati Gundāvane.
mn84:2.2: Samaṇo khalu bho Kaccāno Madhurāyaṃ viharati Gundāvane;
mn84:2.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ Kaccānaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato, --
mn84:2.4: paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho c' eva arahā ca;
mn84:2.5: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
mn84:3.1: Atha kho rājā Madhuro Avantiputto bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhirūhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi Madhurāya niyyāsi mahaccarājānubhāvena āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kaccānam dassanāya;
mn84:3.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko va yen' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmatā Mahā-Kaccānena saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā Madhuro Avantiputto āyasmantaṃ MahāKaccānaṃ etad avoca:
mn84:4.1: Brāhmaṇā, bho Kaccāna, evam āhaṃsu -- Brāhmaṇā
mn84:4.2: va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo;
mn84:4.3: brāhmaṇā va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo;
mn84:4.5: brāhmaṇā Brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāyādā ti.
mn84:5.1: Ghoso yeva kho eso, mahārāja, lokasmiṃ:

mn84:6.2: Idhāssa khattiyo pāṇātipāti adinnādāyi kāmesu micchācārī musāvādī pisuṇāvāco pharusāvāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālū byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhī; kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjeyya? no vā?

mn84:10.1: Evaṃ vutte rājā Madhuro Avantiputto āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kaccānaṃ etad avoca:
mn84:10.2: Abhikkantaṃ, bho Kaccāna, abhikkantaṃ, bho Kaccāna.
mn84:10.3: Seyyathāpi, bho Kaccāna, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya: Cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti;-- evam eva bhotā Kaccānena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn84:10.4: Esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ Kaccānaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca;
mn84:10.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Kaccāno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.
mn84:10.6: Mā kho maṃ tvaṃ, mahārāja, saraṇaṃ agamāsi.
mn84:10.7: Tam eva tvaṃ Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gaccha yam ahaṃ saraṇaṃ gato ti.
mn84:10.8: Kahaṃ pana, bho Kaccāna, etarahi so Bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ti?
mn84:10.9: Parinibbuto kho, mahārāja, etarahi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ti. Sace
mn84:11.1: hi mayaṃ, bho Kaccāna, suṇeyyāma tam Bhagavantaṃ dasasu yojanesu, dasa pi mayaṃ yojanāni gaccheyyāma taṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn84:11.2: Sace hi mayaṃ, bho Kaccāna, suṇeyyāma taṃ Bhagavantaṃ vīsatiyā yojanesu, tiṃsatiyā yojanesu, cattālīsāya yojanesu, paññāsāya yojanesu, -- paññāsam pi mayaṃ yojanāni gaccheyyāma taṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn84:11.3: Yojanasate ce pi mayam, bho Kaccāna, suṇeyyāma taṃ Bhagavantaṃ, yojanasatam pi mayaṃ gaccheyyāma tam Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn84:11.4: Yato ca kho, bho Kaccāna, parinibbuto so Bhagavā, parinibbutam pi mayaṃ taṃ Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca;
